name: shared_lib
detail: Pre-merge branch of upstream PR #19. Its end state landed on upstream main as 1a1bbfd (refactor: Shared lib #19), which the fork contains.
Harden node-serviced updates (open upstream). Squash-ported as f32806d; the fork then changed it in 2cf37a6, f4e8aa1 and e190d3d. See parity/DIVERGENCES.md.

PgBouncer and asyncpg prepared statements (panel#882), open upstream. Ported as 2cfe87b after the docker test c65f806 reproduced it (PgBouncer 1.23: 410 of 640 transactions failed on postgresql, 400 of 640 on timescaledb; 640 of 640 after the port). Not taken: the postgres:17-alpine pin, because fork installs run postgres:latest (18). See parity/DIVERGENCES.md.
doctor, mirror manager and status parsing feature (about 1300 lines), still under upstream review. Port once upstream merges it.
Multiple Telegram chat IDs for backups, written against the backup code before upstream #23/#24 and conflicting with it. Port once upstream merges a rebased version.

New certbot-deploy command for Certbot renewals into the panel volume (panel#829), opened 2026-09-24 and still changing upstream. The fork's installer issues certificates with acme.sh, so no existing install depends on it. Port once upstream merges it.
